_about: Methyl palmitate (1) + Methyl stearate (2): isobaric bubble temperatures at 10.0 kPa (no vapour compositions are fitted). Rows: liquid mole fraction of methyl palmitate, boiling temperature in K, as stored in the ThermoML Archive record (mole fractions of the other component converted with x_1 = 1 - x_2).

source.citation: J. Hou, S. Xu, H. Ding, T. Sun, Isobaric Vapor Liquid Equilibrium of the Mixture of Methyl Palmitate and Methyl Stearate at 0.1 kPa, 1 kPa, 5 kPa, and 10 kPa  , J. Chem. Eng. Data 57 (2012) 2632-2639
source.access: The journal article may be subscription-only; the same data is public in the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (NIST open license).
source.tables: ThermoML record, PureOrMixtureData 4. The table number in the article was not checked.

notes: Read with validation/python/vle_batch.py. Fitted to the bubble temperatures alone (Barker's method): no set of this pair with vapour compositions passes the consistency point test, or none was measured. Pure-component boiling points of the set within 0.90 K of the vapour-pressure records. To be checked by a person against the record (AGENTS.md rule 4).
